core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khan is a Turkic-origin name meaning “Lord, ruler”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Turkic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khan corresponds to the Turkic form خان (Turkic خان (khan)). Its core sense is khan; lord, ruler (turkic). Khan is Turkic خان (khan) 'lord, ruler', widely used as a title and name in South and Central Asia. MISLABELLED ORIGIN: the source recorded the name as Arabic. The source gloss 'Ruler, Chief, Lord' is consistent.
